newsitem.title: INDIA: India Asian sets $6 mln shr issue to IFC.
newsitem.headline: India Asian sets $6 mln shr issue to IFC.

text.p: India's Asian Electronics on Monday approved an increase in foreign institutional investor (FII) holding in the company to 30 percent from 24 percent, a senior official said.

The firm which held a board meeting on Monday also decided to issue preferential shares worth $6 million to International Finance Corporation (IFC) at a price of "not less than 150 rupees per share", Anil Kumar Saboo, the firm's company secretary, told Reuters.
"The company will hold an extraordinary general meeting on May 24 to get shareholder approval," Saboo said.
Former Finance Minister P. Chidambaram raised the FII limit in Indian companies to 30 percent from 24 percent as part of his budget proposals.
Shares of Asian Electronics were kept in check by exchange authorities on Monday, after the stock jumped 11.50 rupees, or 10 percent, to 127.50, dealers said.
Bombay shares are subject to price limits by exchange authorities in the range of 10-20 percent on a daily and weekly basis.
